release_readiness.description: Check latest version relationships + readiness validation

steps.name: ensure_app_id
steps.run: if [[ -z "$APP_ID" ]]; then echo "Set APP_ID in .asc/project.json or pass APP_ID:..." >&2; exit 1; fi

steps.name: latest_version_details
steps.run: VID=$(asc versions list --app "$APP_ID" --platform "$PLATFORM" --limit 200 --output json | jq -r '.data | sort_by(.attributes.createdDate // "") | reverse | .[0].id // empty'); if [[ -z "$VID" ]]; then echo "No versions found for app $APP_ID" >&2; exit 1; fi; asc versions get --version-id "$VID" --include-build --include-submission --output table

steps.name: submission_relationship
steps.run: VID=$(asc versions list --app "$APP_ID" --platform "$PLATFORM" --limit 200 --output json | jq -r '.data | sort_by(.attributes.createdDate // "") | reverse | .[0].id // empty'); asc versions relationships --version-id "$VID" --type appStoreVersionSubmission --output table

steps.name: validate
steps.run: VID=$(asc versions list --app "$APP_ID" --platform "$PLATFORM" --limit 200 --output json | jq -r '.data | sort_by(.attributes.createdDate // "") | reverse | .[0].id // empty'); asc validate --app "$APP_ID" --version-id "$VID" --platform "$PLATFORM" --output table

steps.name: ensure_inputs
steps.run: if [[ -z "$APP_ID" || -z "${VERSION:-}" ]]; then echo "Pass APP_ID and VERSION (e.g. VERSION:1.2.3)" >&2; exit 1; fi
